task_completion.visual_evidence: A TiddlyWiki tiddler with the title 'Exoplanet Explorer' visible in the main display area.

task_completion.description: The dashboard contains a dropdown menu for 'Discovery Method' with the required options.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A select/dropdown element labeled 'Discovery Method' or similar, which when clicked shows 'Transit', 'Radial Velocity', and 'Imaging'.

task_completion.description: The dashboard contains a dropdown menu for 'Planet Type' with the required options.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A select/dropdown element labeled 'Planet Type' or similar, which when clicked shows 'Gas Giant', 'Super Earth', and 'Terrestrial'.

task_completion.description: The selections are configured to be stored in the '$:/state/ExoplanetFilter' state tiddler.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code snippets in the tiddler editor showing '$:/state/ExoplanetFilter' used as the state index for the select widgets, or the '$:/state/ExoplanetFilter' tiddler appearing in the sidebar/recent list with fields 'discovery-method' and 'planet-type'.

task_completion.description: The dashboard displays a list of links to planets that update based on the filter selections.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list of blue links (TiddlyWiki links) appearing below the dropdowns. The list should change or filter when different dropdown options are selected in the screenshots.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler rather than just executing shell scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the TiddlyWiki 'edit' mode active, typing into the text area, and clicking the 'done' (checkmask) button.

integrity.description: The agent implemented a dynamic filter (using [tag[Exoplanet]]) rather than hardcoding a static list of planet names.
integrity.visual_evidence: The tiddler source code in screenshots should contain filter syntax like '[tag[Exoplanet]]' or 'list-links' rather than a manual list of planet names.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific state tiddler requested instead of local variables or temporary storage.
integrity.visual_evidence: The string '$:/state/ExoplanetFilter' is visible within the code editor in the screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dashboard must be titled 'Exoplanet Explorer'. It must use the state tiddler '$:/state/ExoplanetFilter' to store selections in fields 'discovery-method' and 'planet-type'. Valid options for Discovery Method are: Transit, Radial Velocity, Imaging. Valid options for Planet Type are: Gas Giant, Super Earth, Terrestrial. The results must be links to tiddlers tagged 'Exoplanet' that match both selected field values.
